sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: SA CoParents provides two connected tools: a parent app (sacoparentsapp.online) and a professional portal (sacoparentsalign.com).
Contact: mattsossi@bsossi.com, 210-224-1667.

sections.heading: What we collect
bullets: Account information (name, email address, and the role you choose, parent or professional).
Your preparation (reflections, assessments, the safety screening, communication readiness answers, and agreement drafts).
Safety screening (which version you took, A, B, or C, your answers, and a tier; we never ask for or store your sexual orientation).
Records of use (when you accepted this notice, and when assigned professionals view your information).

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: To run the tools you ask for, to build reports for professionals you authorize, and to keep the service safe.
We don't sell your information.

sections.heading: Who can see it
bullets: You, always.
Your co-parent, never your individual answers, reflections, or screening.
Assigned professionals may see individual screening answers on a protected screen, and each view is logged.
Courts, only what you authorize, or what the law or a court order requires.
Service providers: email delivery (Resend).

sections.heading: Keeping it safe
paragraphs: We limit access by role and keep access logs.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Raw screening answers are deleted 90 days after the case closes or the account is deleted, whichever comes first. Court submissions are kept for 6 months from the date they are submitted.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask to see what we hold and to delete your account. Deleting your account does not remove a record already submitted to a court.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: The tools are for adult parents. We collect information about children only as you or a professional enter it.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If this notice changes, we'll show it again and ask you to confirm.

sections.heading: What this page is
paragraphs: This page describes the protections SA CoParents Align has in place today. It is written to be accurate rather than reassuring: where a protection depends on our hosting provider, we say so.

sections.heading: Private by default
bullets: Each parent's answers, reflections, and safety screening are stored under that parent's own record and are never returned to the co-parent by any screen, report, PDF, or email.
Joint reports show the generated comparison only. Family-violence screenings are never compared or shared with the other parent.
Court and professional documents show only that a screening was received, a tier, and a neutral pathway label confirmed by the assigned professional.

sections.heading: Who can see what
bullets: Parents see their own information.
Assigned professionals see individual screening answers on a protected screen. Every view is written to an access log with who viewed, what, and when.
Judges receive only the frozen court submission a professional chose to send, through a time-limited link and access code.
Administrators manage approvals and listings; they do not have a screen that shows screening answers.

sections.heading: Account security
bullets: Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes; we never store or email plain-text passwords.
Sessions use short-lived, HTTP-only, secure cookies (30-minute access, 7-day refresh).
Sign-in is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.
Password-reset codes are hashed, expire in 15 minutes, and work once.

sections.heading: Court submissions
bullets: When a professional submits to a court, the PDF is frozen and its SHA-256 fingerprint is recorded, so the court can confirm the document was not altered.
Judge access links expire after 30 days and can be re-issued by the professional.

sections.heading: Analytics and tracking
paragraphs: We do not run analytics or session-recording scripts in the app. Cookies are used only to keep you signed in.

sections.heading: Service providers
bullets: Email delivery (Resend): recipient address, subject, and links. Never screening answers.
Hosting and database (Emergent): the application and its database run on Emergent's infrastructure.
Research summaries (Perplexity): only category labels, a joint rating, and a professional's ZIP code. Never names, case numbers, or answers.
Report drafting assistant (Google Gemini via Emergent): case code, parent and child names, and the professional's draft text. Never screening answers.

sections.heading: Your controls
bullets: You can delete your account from your dashboard. Your answers and screening are removed from the case immediately.
Records already submitted to a court stay with the court.
A Quick Exit button on safety screens leaves the page immediately and clears it from your browser.

sections.heading: Reporting a concern
paragraphs: If you believe information has been exposed or you have found a security problem, email mattsossi@bsossi.com or call 210-224-1667. We will investigate and respond in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: Private by default
paragraphs: Your answers, reflections, and journal entries belong to you. Your co-parent does not see them.

sections.heading: Safety first
paragraphs: If you report family violence concerns, we limit what appears in joint reports, invitations, and email. Reports show only that your screening was received, a tier, and a neutral pathway label. They never show your raw answers, your narrative, or your locations, and the version appears only as a neutral label.

sections.heading: Professionals
paragraphs: Assigned professionals can see individual screening answers on a protected screen. Every view is logged. They receive reports built from what you authorize.

sections.heading: Limits
paragraphs: Using SA CoParents does not create an attorney-client, therapist-patient, or other legally privileged relationship. Information may be subject to lawful disclosure, including subpoenas and court orders.

sections.heading: If you are in danger now
bullets: Call 911.
National Domestic Violence Hotline: 1-800-799-7233 (text START to 88788).
San Antonio, Family Violence Prevention Services 24-hour line: 210-733-8810.

sections.heading: You choose what to share
paragraphs: In your Self Journey you choose which completed reports to share and with whom. Sharing one report does not give access to your account or your private journal.

sections.heading: How consent works
numbered: You select a report and a recipient.
You see what the recipient will receive before it's sent.
You can stop sharing going forward at any time.

sections.heading: Joint and court-ordered participation
paragraphs: If a court or professional requires your participation, separate rules apply. We'll tell you what is required before you start.

sections.heading: Professionals' reports
paragraphs: A professional may build a report from what you authorize. A frozen court submission can't be changed afterward.

sections.heading: Safety exceptions
paragraphs: If safety concerns are flagged, a professional may recommend structured communication or additional safeguards. This is a flag for their judgment, not a decision about custody.

sections.heading: Withdrawing
paragraphs: You can delete your account. Records already submitted to a court stay with the court.
